corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Proposal: Warehouse Inventory Dashboard

**Submitted by:** Vantix Analytics

## Executive Summary
Vantix Analytics is pleased to submit this aligned proposal for the NordFrame Logistics Warehouse Inventory Dashboard. Our solution provides a centralized, secure web-based dashboard that integrates directly with your existing PostgreSQL database across all 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria. Delivered through a disciplined 6-month phased rollout—beginning with a working pilot at one warehouse in 3 months—our solution ensures strict role-based access control, automated low-stock alerts, and reliable ongoing support, all within your budgeted envelope.

## Proposed Technical Solution
- **Web-Based Dashboard:** Responsive, real-time interface tracking inventory across all 6 sites.
- **PostgreSQL Integration:** Direct connection to your existing PostgreSQL database with zero migration required.
- **Role-Based Access Control:** Granular security ensuring warehouse managers view only their site; HQ views all.
- **Automated Alerts:** Configurable low-stock triggers and notifications.
- **Phased Rollout:** 6-month structured deployment starting with a 3-month pilot at one warehouse.
- **Support & Maintenance:** Year 1 support with defined SLAs (4-hour critical response time).

## Timeline
- **Months 1–3:** Discovery, dashboard architecture, and working pilot deployment at one warehouse.
- **Months 4–6:** Phased rollout to the remaining 5 regional warehouses, comprehensive staff training, and full project sign-off.

## Pricing
Total project investment: **€98,000**, covering all development, deployment, training, and the first year of support and maintenance.
